fieldNotes.site: Columbus A-B brewery (opened 1968), documented ~138-acre site at 700 Schrock Rd. Brewery building with adjacent large trailer drop yards to the NW/W and rail service.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is fully fenced (chain-link confirmed along Schrock Rd in Street View). Main Schrock Rd entrance is a landscaped boulevard with an A-B monument sign and a 'No Trucks' sign - trucks are routed to a dedicated truck gate elsewhere on the perimeter. Truck gate not crisply resolved in Street View (internal roads not on SV) - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A-B breweries operate guarded truck entrances as standard practice; the 'No Trucks' sign at the visitor entrance confirms a separate controlled truck gate. Booth structure not directly imaged - classified guardShack TRUE per site type, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large organized trailer drop yards NW and W of the brewery, ~200+ trailers, capacity ~350.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank with trailers backed in visible on the brewery building; estimated ~32 (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail spurs run into the campus and trailer yards.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal roads and yard aprons leave room to add lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Documented 138 acres; boxed footprint approximates this.

citations.claim: AB Columbus OH brewery at 700 Schrock Rd, opened 1968, listed as operating.
AB launching its Columbus Regional Excellence Center, confirming active Columbus operations.

verification.rationale: Columbus brewery operating; named as host of a new 2025 Regional Excellence Center investment; not in closure set.
